intervention: Execute the original pretrained R3 public NativeActive or separately FIT-trained conventional BayesianActive until the FIRST actual turn which the source-public unseen-vs-known rule changes. Clone ONLY the evaluator's original-source wrapped environment and exact online learner state at that instant. The policy receives no cloned simulator state or private original map. On one clone force the chosen information-facing turn, and on the other force its opposite non-information-facing turn; both cost precisely one physical source action, with identical preaction public state, original source RNG state, FIT weights and learned preaction memory. Thereafter disable additional information-turn heuristic in BOTH fork arms, use respective memory-enabled native or independent conventional planner; each receives only its OWN real action and public consequences. This identifies effect of that *intervention action* but not information separately from heading/route change.
native_blinded_extra: On THIRD matching evaluator clone take SAME information-facing turn as native informative branch. At the immediate next decision, erase the newly exposed front obstacle bit for that single decision, substitute nonprivileged optimistic unknown/default-clear into the memory-update input, then delete that synthetic edge entry before actually executing its next selected legal action. All subsequent genuine source observations/consequences stay intact. This predeclared one-reading sensor ablation is intentionally information-restricting and does not claim identical internal state after divergence. Native info and native blinded have identical real first-turn trajectories and source RNG until the first post-turn choice.
no_trigger: If a new source episode contains no actual eligible first probe, record it as non-forked with zero paired evidence and do not impute counterfactual reward.
